child.text:
[{"insert":"Power Clean

A power clean complex every two to three minutes across five sets. The power clean catches the bar above parallel, which demands a fast pull and an aggressive elbow turnover before the hips fully open. This week pairs the clean with hang cleans and a box jump to train speed and force together. Sets 1 and 2 are easy, 3 and 4 moderate, and 5 challenging, so dial in the pull before adding weight.
"}]

Loading Note:
Perform 2-3 warmup sets. Set 1-4: aim for RPE 7, 8, 9, 10, respectively. The accumulated fatigue from each set should make the next set harder. This means you may increase weight, or you may keep the weight the same to match the prescribed RPE.
RPE = Rate of Perceived Exertion - scale of 10, where 10 is form failure.
